info.name: STOKANA API
info.description: End-to-end collection for the STOKANA multi-vendor marketplace. Import the STOKANA local environment, then run the folders in order: setup, catalogue, seller, admin, buyer, fulfilment, messages, seller inbox and reviews. The buyer flow places a real demo order and pays it with the simulated provider. Do not run this against production data.

item.name: 1. Setup & auth
item.description: Sign in with the seeded demo accounts. Postman replaces its session cookie automatically, so run the login request for whichever role you need next.

request.description: Confirms the API and PostgreSQL connection are healthy.
Public catalogue counters used by the home page.
Creates a fresh buyer with a unique email. Not required by the rest of the collection, which uses the seeded buyer.
Creates a pending shop with a unique email. The admin approval request uses newSellerProfileId, so this is a safe way to demonstrate the approval workflow.

{
  "fullName": "Postman Seller",
  "email": "postman.seller.{{$timestamp}}@stokana.test",
  "phone": "0722 000 222",
  "password": "Postman@2026",
  "role": "seller",
  "shopName": "Postman Shop {{$timestamp}}",
  "shopDescription": "Temporary shop created by the Postman collection.",
  "shopCounty": "Nairobi",
  "shopTown": "Westlands"
}

request.description: Signs in as the seeded administrator.
Signs in as the seeded buyer, Faith Wambui.
Signs in as Nairobi Tech Hub, an approved seller.
Returns the account for the current session cookie, or null when signed out.

item.name: 2. Public catalogue
item.description: Public endpoints — no session required. Category, product and shop ids are saved for later requests.

request.description: Stores the first two active categories for product creation and filtering.

exec: pm.test('At least two active categories exist', () => pm.expect(active.length).to.be.at.least(2));

request.description: Keyword search used by the Explore page. Also stores a seed product slug for the product-detail request.
Filters an active category and sorts by popularity.
Full product page payload with images, seller, related products and the latest reviews.
Paginated buyer reviews for a product.
Verified shop directory. Stores the first shop slug for the detail request.
Shop profile plus its approved products.

item.name: 3. Seller
item.description: Signs in as the seeded approved seller. Creates a product that the admin approves in the next folder.

request.description: Products, low stock, sales, earnings, recent orders and unread messages.

request.description: Adds a second product image and stores imageId for the primary/delete requests.
Choose a local image file in the request body before sending. Uses the server upload or Cloudinary when configured.
Marks the added image as the primary product image.
Removes the image added by URL.
Paid orders for this seller. Stores the shipment id for the most recent order.

exec: const order = orders.find((entry) => String(entry.orderNumber) === String(target)) || orders[0];

request.description: Monthly gross sales, commission and earnings history.

item.name: 4. Admin
item.description: Signs in as the administrator, approves the optional new shop and the product created above, then inspects platform data.

request.description: Review queue for new shops. Stores the first pending shop profile id.
Approves the shop created by Register seller (optional). Change the id to pendingSellerProfileId if you want to approve an existing application.
Product moderation queue. Stores the first pending product id.
Publishes the product created in the Seller folder so it appears in the catalogue and can be bought.
Optional from/to query parameters use YYYY-MM-DD.
Current commission rate, shipping fee and free-shipping threshold. PATCH the same endpoint to change them.

item.name: 5. Buyer cart & orders
item.description: Uses the seeded buyer and the admin-approved test product. Places a real order and pays it with the simulated provider.

request.description: Adds the test product and stores the cart item id.
Creates the order, reserves stock, calculates commission server-side and creates a pending simulated payment.

request.description: Returns the existing pending payment instead of creating a duplicate.
Server verifies the amount, marks the order paid, and creates commissions and one shipment per seller.
A duplicate successful callback must be ignored.
Full order with items, payments and shipment links. Stores orderItemId for the review flow.

exec: if (item) { pm.collectionVariables.set('orderItemId', item.id); if (item.shipmentId) pm.collectionVariables.set('shipmentId', item.shipmentId); }

request.description: Only works while an order is still pending_payment. The main collection pays the order, so create another unpaid order before using this request.

item.name: 6. Seller fulfilment
item.description: Switches back to the seller, dispatches and delivers the paid order so the buyer can review it.

request.description: Finds the paid order and stores its shipment id.

exec: const order = orders.find((entry) => String(entry.orderNumber) === String(target)) || orders[0];

item.name: 7. Messages
item.description: Buyer side of a conversation with the seeded seller. The seller side follows.

request.description: Opens or reuses the buyer–seller conversation and stores conversationId.
Returns the conversation and up to 200 messages, and marks incoming messages as read.

item.name: 8. Seller inbox
item.description: Seller side of the same conversation, proving both participants see the same thread.

exec: pm.test('Conversation participants are correct', () => { const c = pm.response.json().conversation; pm.expect(String(c.buyerId)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('buyerId'))); });

item.name: 9. Reviews
item.description: Signs back in as the buyer and reviews the delivered order item.

request.description: Lists the buyer’s reviews and delivered items waiting for a review.
Requires a delivered order item that has not been reviewed yet.
